properties.name: concord:sbom:method
properties.value: Hand-authored manifest: the C++ CRDT core, concord-worker, and the WASM build vendor ZERO third-party dependencies (verified in P6-M025 — cpp/*/CMakeLists.txt use no FetchContent/ExternalProject/find_package of externals; C++20 standard library only), so the SBOM surface is the components themselves plus the build toolchains. Toolchain versions are captured at generation time via --version (mirrors scripts/bench/capture-env.mjs).

components.name: concord-worker
components.description: C++ native snapshot/restore worker (cpp/worker): C++20 stdlib only, no third-party libraries

components.name: concord-crdt-cpp
components.description: C++ CRDT core (cpp/crdt): header+impl C++20 stdlib only, no third-party libraries

components.name: concord-crdt-wasm
components.description: WASM build of the SAME C++ CRDT core (wasm/): compiled with the Emscripten toolchain; identical source to the native component, browser-side replica engine

components.name: clang-toolchain
components.description: C/C++ compiler used for native builds (build-time dependency)

components.name: ninja-build-runner
components.description: Build runner for native + WASM builds (build-time dependency)

components.name: emscripten-toolchain
components.version: emcc (Emscripten gcc/clang-like replacement + linker emulating GNU ld) 6.0.9-git
components.description: Emscripten toolchain for the WASM CRDT build (build-time dependency)
